messages:
June (CS): Heads-up: PulseBridge asked for a short split-region routing + allowlist for a cross-region compliance demo. They want requests from EU to stay in eu-west-1 and APAC to ap-southeast-1. Renewal touchpoint in ~10 days so this is high-priority. Can SRE create a per-account routing policy + allowlist and add a header check on SNI for the demo?

Marco (Acct Exec): They called out multi-region proofs in the RFP. If we can show deterministic routing and region header X-Region-Routed it helps the exec review. I'll be on the demo.

Leah (SRE): We can do route-by-source-cidr -> region mapping plus SNI header assert. Need exact CIDRs and SNI pattern. Also confirm window and QPS.

June (CS): CIDRs: EU proxies 198.51.100.0/26, APAC proxies 203.0.113.64/26. They use SNI 'demo.pulsebridge.net' and will include header X-PB-Token. Window: 2026-05-05T09:30:00Z -> 2026-05-05T13:30:00Z (4h). QPS per region: EU 140, APAC 160, burst 300 combined. Customer PB-3009. They also want audit log entries and a short retention note for demo traces only.

Ravi (Solutions): Recommend spinning up KV-cache warmup and a short 10m ramp where we gradually increase QPS. I'll provide the harness and will tag prompts to measure per-region p95. Also will add a note to mask prompt contents in telemetry.

Leah (SRE): Draft config below. Plan: apply canary in each region (5m) then roll full. Rollback if p95 > 220ms or errors > 1% in canary.

Leah (SRE): ```json
{
  "customer_id":"PB-3009",
  "region_rules":[{"cidr":"198.51.100.0/26","region":"eu-west-1"},{"cidr":"203.0.113.64/26","region":"ap-southeast-1"}],
  "sni_assert":"demo.pulsebridge.net",
  "require_header":"X-PB-Token",
  "response_header":"X-Region-Routed",
  "rate_limits":{"eu_qps":"140","apac_qps":"160","burst":"300"},
  "start":"2026-05-05T09:30:00Z",
  "end":"2026-05-05T13:30:00Z",
  "canary":{"duration":"5m","rollback_p95_ms":220,"rollback_error_pct":1},
  "telemetry":"masked_prompts_aggregate",
  "audit_log":true,
  "notes":"4h split-region demo; deterministic routing and SNI header assert; auto-revoke; record X-Region-Routed in responses"
}
```

infra-bot: Ticket CS-7342 created. Initiating canary in eu-west-1 at 6180004400. Requestor: Leah.

Leah (SRE): Canary in eu-west-1 passed quick checks (p95 85ms, errors 0.0%). Starting ap-southeast-1 canary now.

Leah (SRE): ap-southeast-1 canary passed (p95 110ms, errors 0.2%). Rolling both regions to full apply. Applied at 6180004560.

June (CS): Nice work :clap: I'll notify PulseBridge and include the X-Region-Routed header note. Marco  please draft a short renewal follow-up tying demo success to the renewal incentive. Ravi  share the warmup harness link and test plan.

Marco (Acct Exec): Will prepare renewal note. Suggest offering a 6-month pilot contract if p95 < 150ms and error < 0.5% for 72h post-demo.

Ravi (Solutions): Warmup harness uploaded to /shared/cs/warmups/PB-3009 and scheduled to run 30m before start. Link: https://internal.storage/warmups/PB-3009

June (CS): Closing the loop. Auto-revoke set. We'll collect telemetry and add to the CRM note after demo.
